articles.title: Ex-Congress Leader Booked After Allegedly Threatening Farmers With Pistol in Land Dispute
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A former member of the Madhya Pradesh Congress Committee has been booked after he allegedly threatened farmers with a pistol during a land dispute in Ujjain district. A video of the incident has surfaced, following which police registered a case and launched an investigation.

body.html:
A former member of the Madhya Pradesh Congress Committee has been booked after he allegedly threatened farmers with a pistol during a land dispute in Ujjain district. A video of the incident has surfaced, following which police registered a case and launched an investigation.

The video purportedly shows former Congress leader and district panchayat member representative Pratap Singh Gur holding what appears to be a pistol. He is also heard saying, "Haan, le video," to the person recording before forcefully pushing the mobile phone away.

According to police, the incident took place on June 18 near Isankhedi Tiraha in Mahidpur. Complainant Govind Sen, a resident of Delchibuzurg village, alleged that he had gone to his field to collect stored fodder when Pratap Singh Gur arrived with two others and began digging a trench near the field using a JCB machine.

Govind claimed that he and his brother objected to the digging, leading to an argument during which Pratap Singh Gur and the others allegedly abused them. He further alleged that when his family members reached the spot to pacify the situation, Pratap Singh Gur took out a pistol, pointed it at them, and threatened to kill them if they did not leave, saying the JCB work would continue.

Police said action was initiated after the video surfaced. The footage allegedly shows Pratap Singh Gur holding a pistol and pushing away the mobile phone of the person recording the incident.

Pratap Singh Gur has denied all the allegations. He claimed he was waiting for official land measurement and had brought the JCB to remove iron angles placed on his land. He also alleged that the complainant's family threatened him and claimed the FIR was part of a conspiracy orchestrated at the behest of BJP leaders.

Police said the matter is under investigation.

articles.title: Weekend Trip Ends in Tragedy: 25-Year-Old Man Drowns in Resort Pool During Friends' Getaway
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A weekend trip to the Konkan coast turned tragic after a 25-year-old man from Kolhapur drowned in the swimming pool of a resort in Malvan, Sindhudurg district, on June 21.

body.html:
A weekend trip to the Konkan coast turned tragic after a 25-year-old man from Kolhapur drowned in the swimming pool of a resort in Malvan, Sindhudurg district, on June 21.

The deceased has been identified as Shrenik Milind Takale, a resident of Kasba Sangaon village in Kagal taluka of Kolhapur district.

According to police, Takale and nine of his friends had travelled to Malvan, around 500 km from Mumbai, for a vacation. The group arrived between 4 pm and 5 pm on June 20 and checked into Malvani Pahunchar Restaurant and Resort, a budget-friendly homestay-style property.

The incident occurred at around 3 pm on June 21, shortly after lunch. Police said Takale jumped into the resort's swimming pool, which is around 4 to 4.5 feet deep, while his friends were already inside, playing a game and listening to music.

When Takale did not resurface for an unusually long time, his friends realised something was wrong. They immediately pulled him out of the water and found him unconscious.

He was rushed to the Rural Hospital in Malvan, where doctors declared him dead on arrival. The preliminary cause of death has been attributed to asphyxiation due to submersion.

Police said there is no evidence of foul play so far. An Accidental Death Report (ADR) has been registered, and further inquiries are underway to establish the exact sequence of events. The body has been sent for post-mortem examination, and the exact cause of death will be confirmed after the medical report is received.

articles.title: Missed Exit Turns Fatal: Family of Four Killed After Car Reverses on Delhi-Dehradun Expressway
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A family of four was killed in a horrific road accident on the Delhi-Dehradun Expressway after their car allegedly reversed on the highway upon missing a cut and was hit from behind by a speeding Scorpio SUV.

body.html:
A family of four was killed in a horrific road accident on the Delhi-Dehradun Expressway after their car allegedly reversed on the highway upon missing a cut and was hit from behind by a speeding Scorpio SUV.

The accident occurred near the Halgoya Cut in Uttar Pradesh's Saharanpur district. CCTV footage of the crash, which has surfaced on social media, shows the family's car crossing the cut before reversing in an apparent attempt to return to the missed exit.

According to reports, the driver was reversing towards the cut from an under-construction stretch of the highway when the speeding Scorpio rammed into the car from behind. The impact dragged the car several metres, completely mangling it, while the Scorpio lost control and overturned.

The family was travelling from Bahadurgarh in Haryana to Haridwar for a holy dip in the Ganga and temple darshan when the accident occurred.

Four occupants died on the spot. The deceased were identified as Praveen (40), his wife Preeti (37), his mother Sudesh, and nine-year-old Shivansh. Three other family members sustained serious injuries and were admitted to the district hospital's Trauma Centre.

Police and district administration officials rushed to the spot after the crash. District Magistrate Arvind Kumar Chauhan and Senior Superintendent of Police Abhinandan later visited the injured at the hospital and directed officials to ensure proper treatment.

Police have sent the bodies for post-mortem examination and launched an investigation. The CCTV footage is being analysed as part of the probe to determine the exact cause of the accident.

articles.title: High-Speed Car Crash at Ahmedabad's Yog Circle Leaves Multiple Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A high-speed collision between two cars caused panic at Yog Circle in Ahmedabad on Saturday after the vehicles crashed into each other with massive force.

body.html:
A high-speed collision between two cars caused panic at Yog Circle in Ahmedabad on Saturday after the vehicles crashed into each other with massive force.

According to preliminary reports, one car was travelling from Karnavati Club Road while the other was approaching from the Shela side when they collided. The impact left both vehicles extensively damaged.

Two to three people reportedly sustained injuries and were rushed to a nearby hospital for treatment. The entire incident was captured on CCTV, and further details are awaited.

articles.title: Speeding Autorickshaw Overturns, Crashes Into Pedestrian in Mangaluru
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A pedestrian sustained serious injuries after a speeding autorickshaw allegedly lost control, overturned, and crashed into him near Mudipu on the outskirts of Mangaluru on Thursday afternoon.

body.html:
A pedestrian sustained serious injuries after a speeding autorickshaw allegedly lost control, overturned, and crashed into him near Mudipu on the outskirts of Mangaluru on Thursday afternoon.

The accident occurred at around 3:45 pm when the autorickshaw, reportedly travelling at high speed, went out of the driver's control and overturned onto the roadside before hitting the pedestrian.

The entire incident was captured on a nearby CCTV camera, with the footage showing the autorickshaw overturning before crashing into the pedestrian.

The injured man was seriously hurt in the accident. Traffic police have registered a case and launched an investigation into the incident.

articles.title: 9-Year-Old Girl Hit by Speeding Bike After Getting Off School Bus in Beed
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A serious road accident in Maharashtra's Beed has raised fresh concerns over the safety of students travelling in school buses after a 9-year-old girl was hit by a speeding motorcycle while crossing the road after getting off her school bus.

body.html:
A serious road accident in Maharashtra's Beed has raised fresh concerns over the safety of students travelling in school buses after a 9-year-old girl was hit by a speeding motorcycle while crossing the road after getting off her school bus.

According to reports, the incident took place in the Gayanagar area near Gurukul Public School on Saturday. The injured student, identified as Abhijit Madiwale (9), had just alighted from the school bus and was crossing the road when a speeding bike coming from the opposite direction struck her, leaving her seriously injured.

She was immediately rushed to a private hospital in Beed, where she is currently undergoing treatment.

Police, including officials from the Traffic Branch, visited the hospital after receiving information about the incident. Police Inspector Vaibhav Patil said that the responsibility for ensuring the safe drop-off of students lies with both the school bus driver and the school management. He added that notices will be issued to schools to ensure strict compliance with traffic rules, and action will be taken against violations. A meeting with school managements is also expected.

The incident has once again highlighted concerns over school transport safety, blind spots around school buses, and compliance with mandatory safety protocols.

body.html:
A dramatic street altercation was reported on Sahastradhara Road in Dehradun on Friday evening, where a woman allegedly pelted stones at a man following an argument.

As the man ran to protect himself, the woman allegedly turned her attention to his scooter, repeatedly hitting it with stones and causing significant damage.

A video of the incident shows the man pleading, "The scooter is rented, please don't break it!" Despite his repeated requests, the woman allegedly continued damaging the vehicle.

The exact reason behind the dispute is yet to be ascertained. No official statement has been issued by the authorities regarding the incident so far.

articles.title: Doctor Says She's Fine, Woman Allegedly Attacks Hospital Staff Before Driving Away
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A woman allegedly attacked doctors and hospital staff at a private hospital in Hyderabad's LB Nagar after being informed that she was not in any danger. The incident took place at Shreshta Orange Hospital on Saturday, June 27.

body.html:
A woman allegedly attacked doctors and hospital staff at a private hospital in Hyderabad's LB Nagar after being informed that she was not in any danger.

The incident took place at Shreshta Orange Hospital on Saturday, June 27. The woman, identified as Lalitha Karira, was admitted to the hospital but allegedly turned violent after doctors informed her that her condition was not serious.

A video circulating on social media shows the woman kicking and assaulting hospital staff before leaving the hospital premises and driving away.

According to LB Nagar Police, the woman is a business partner of the hospital owners. "We are verifying the cause of the fight and are yet to register a case," police said.
